# Agentcy — AI Engineers on Site | Ballito & Knysna | South Africa

Last updated: 2026-07-14

Agentcy provides AI engineers to South African businesses to eliminate operational drag through workflow automation, AI integration, and custom tool development. Based in Ballito and Knysna, we serve clients nationwide.

Key information:
- Founded: 2023
- Location: Ballito & Knysna, South Africa
- Services: Workflow automation, AI integration, custom tools, on-site engineering
- Industries served: Various (including finance, healthcare, logistics)

For more information, visit https://www.agentcy.co.za
